title: Recording: Have I Told You Lately That I Love You by Ringo Starr | 1970
content:
A&M Studios, Los Angeles, USA

Sentimental Journey, Ringo Starr’s debut solo album, featured 12 pre-rock ‘n’ roll standards, each arranged by a different musician.

On 3 February 1970 the backing track for ‘Have I Told You Lately That I Love You?’ was recorded at A&M Studios in Los Angeles. Arranged by Elmer Bernstein, it featured electric guitar, piano, organ, brass, violin, bass, drums and bird whistle.

Starr, who was not present for the LA session, overdubbed his lead vocals at Abbey Road on 9 and 18 February 1970.
